2) AppState::tryStartWorker() has the in-process libaicad fallback gated `#ifndef _WIN32` (host/src/core/app_state.cpp:580) â€” Linux-only. That's why AI_CAD_SHOT=m1 HANGS headless on Windows (no Python worker started -> dead-ends in provisioning, no stdout diag). Intended (Windows = Python-worker-only), or do you want a Windows libaicad fallback? Your call â€” I won't touch host/ worker routing without it.
3) Proposed SMALL host/src/ui/scenarios.cpp hook: trigger ViewPreset::ZoomFit + wait for the camera tween to settle BEFORE the headless capture, so shots frame the part. Needed to close the T-WIN1 viewport parity check headlessly (right now the solid builds â€” FM shows Body1/Boss-Extrude1 â€” but the capture is off-frame because scenarios never fire a view preset and ZoomFit is animated). Low-risk, capture-only, Linux-safe. OK to write it on the T-WIN1 branch for your review?

FYI (visibility): 2 new P3 tasks going to the board via foreman â€” (a) simulation PERF optimization of existing FEA/CFD/meshing (simulation lane), (b) AI provider token-efficiency incl. local-model test fallback (ai-copilot lane, your neighbor).
